tasks.label: Scaffold React Native with npm approval
Validate React Native app
args: npm.cmd --prefix apps/mobile-react-native run typecheck; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm.cmd --prefix apps/mobile-react-native test -- --runInBand; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm.cmd --prefix apps/mobile-react-native run lint

tasks.label: Activate React Native app at apps mobile
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Test-Path 'apps\mobile-flutter') { throw 'apps/mobile-flutter already exists; refusing to overwrite it.' }; if (Test-Path 'apps\mobile-react-native\.git') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'apps\mobile-react-native\.git' -Recurse -Force }; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'apps\mobile' -Destination 'apps\mobile-flutter'; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'apps\mobile-react-native' -Destination 'apps\mobile'

tasks.label: Move RN app into mobile folder
args: $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; if (Test-Path "apps\mobile-flutter") { throw "apps/mobile-flutter exists" }; if (Test-Path "apps\mobile-react-native\.git") { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "apps\mobile-react-native\.git" -Recurse -Force }; Move-Item -LiteralPath "apps\mobile" -Destination "apps\mobile-flutter"; Move-Item -LiteralPath "apps\mobile-react-native" -Destination "apps\mobile"
